[LREG.2.2] `DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_LET_NO_CAPTURES` and
`DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_LET_TUPLE_FORM` are reserved allocations, out of use
([STYL.2.8.7]).
`specs/registry/validate.ebnf` keeps both as non-alternation productions,
and a compiler must not raise either. A match in `let` position is
[LREG.2.1]'s `DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_CAPTURE_IN_LET`.
